payload.question: Is the council borrowing more than it is allowed to?
payload.label: Borrowing against the limit full Council set, 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council is heavily under-borrowed — it uses its own cash instead of taking loans. That changes in 2026/27, when the strategy plans about £42m of new external borrowing, taking gross debt to £188.6m.
payload.evidence: Full Council sets a legal ceiling on borrowing every year, called the authorised limit. For 2025/26 it was £344.409m. The council's actual external debt was £145.948m, about 42% of what it was allowed. Nearly all of it is Public Works Loan Board money — government lending at government rates.
